points.quote: Inappropriate use of artificial intelligence software or services in the completion of assessments. Assignment briefs will identify where use of artificial intelligence may be appropriate; in all other cases it is not.
points.gist: Inappropriate AI use in assessments is misconduct; assignment briefs say where AI may be appropriate and elsewhere it is not.

points.quote: Attempting to manipulate or evade academic integrity detection processes or software (e.g. Turnitin).
points.gist: Trying to manipulate or evade integrity detection processes or software such as Turnitin is misconduct.
